description: Image Description: The image shows a fire hydrant situated on a grassy area beside a street. The hydrant is predominantly white with a blue top. It has two side nozzles, each with a metal cap attached by chains. The words "KENNETT SQUARE" and the number "150" are visible on the hydrant. In the background, there is a paved road with a curb and some greenery, including grass and trees. A vertical metal pole is positioned near the hydrant
